snippet.title: Tetris Effect: Connected Party Edition Launch Trailer | Amazon Luna
snippet.description:
Tetris® Effect: Connected Party Edition is loaded with exciting multiplayer modes from Tetris Effect: Connected, plus the exciting new Mystery Battle Mode!

CONNECTED: Three players can team up and literally connect their Tetris Matrices to fight against A.I.-controlled Bosses.

Mystery Battle: Up to four players can compete to be the last one standing while dodging unpredictable hazards. New mode exclusive to Luna.

Zone Battle: A one-on-one match of standard competitive Tetris, but with a twist: the time-stopping Zone mechanic.

Score Attack and Classic Score Attack: Two single-player versus modes where two players compete separately to see who can get the best score.

Play Tetris Effect: Connected Party Edition on Luna, included with Prime. 
https://luna.amazon.com/game/tetris-effect-connected-party-edition/B0FP26PXGD

https://luna.amazon.com/
